result.question: Who should I start Trey Mcbride or Bowers for week 7
result.answer: Start Brock Bowers over Trey McBride. Bowers = Brock Bowers, LV TE. Brock Bowers has higher seasonal PPR points per game (20.6 vs 17.2) and a stronger recent weekly trend (18.2 vs 14.7 in weeks 4-6), giving him a consistent production edge despite Trey McBride's more favorable week 7 matchup against a Denver defense allowing 13.2 PPR points to TEs and lower touchdown dependency. The overall scoring advantage for Bowers outweighs the matchup and dependency factors.

claims.text: Trey McBride: ARI, TE, roster status ACT (week 7).

evidence.sql: SELECT r.gsis_id, r.full_name, r.team, r.position, r.status, r.week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters r JOIN (SELECT gsis_id, MAX(week) AS week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters WHERE season = 2026 AND REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(full_name), ' (jr|sr|ii|iii|iv)[.]?$', '') IN ('trey mcbride', 'who should', 'should i', 'i start', 'start trey', 'mcbride or', 'or bowers', 'bowers for', 'for week', 'who should i', 'should i start', 'i start trey', 'start trey mcbride', 'trey mcbride or', 'mcbride or bowers', 'or bowers for', 'bowers for week') GROUP BY gsis_id) latest ON r.gsis_id = latest.gsis_id AND r.week = latest.week WHERE r.season = 2026 AND r.position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE') ORDER BY r.full_name

claims.text: Brock Bowers: LV, TE, 82.2 PPR points this season.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, ps.team, COUNT(*) AS games, SUM(ps.targets) AS targets, ROUND(100 * AVG(ps.target_share), 1) AS avg_target_share_pct, ROUND(100 * AVG(ps.air_yards_share), 1) AS avg_air_yards_share_pct, SUM(ps.carries) AS carries, ROUND(AVG(ps.fantasy_points_ppr), 1) AS ppr_per_game FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037744', '00-0039338') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name, ps.team ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

claims.text: Brock Bowers averaged 18.2 PPR points per game in later weeks compared to Trey McBride's 14.7, making Bowers the stronger start based on recent trend.

claims.text: Trey McBride has 17.5% of his PPR points from touchdowns compared to Brock Bowers's 21.9%, making McBride less touchdown-dependent and steadier.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) AS touchdowns, 6 * SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) AS td_points, ROUND(SUM(ps.fantasy_points_ppr), 1) AS ppr_points, ROUND(100 * 6 * SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) / NULLIF(SUM(ps.fantasy_points_ppr), 0), 1) AS td_share_pct FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0037744', '00-0039338') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name ORDER BY ps.player_display_name
